# Test files deliberately NOT reachable from any pytest invocation.
#
# Format: one entry per line, `path  # reason`.
# An entry with no reason FAILS the guard. An unexplained exclusion is
# indistinguishable from an oversight, and that ambiguity is what let this
# problem recur; see scripts/check_test_enumeration.py.
#
# An entry that is no longer needed also fails the guard: once a file is
# enumerated, its exclusion is stale and must be deleted rather than left to
# rot into a false record of intent.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BASELINE BACKLOG, measured at main@1c13147f45365c10d518356a429f757c740f3a06
# by `python scripts/check_test_enumeration.py` with no allowlist present:
# 399 test files discovered, 213 reachable by no pytest invocation.
#
# These 213 are recorded, not endorsed. Enumerating them means editing the
# pytest invocations in .github/workflows/qa-tests.yml, which this change is
# not permitted to touch, so it is scheduled as separate work. The guard's
# purpose here is to stop the list growing: a NEW unenumerated test file fails
# CI immediately, because it will not be in this file.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
